literal: Restart com operação incerta ou filho ainda vivo não repete trabalho nem libera claim/slot indevidamente.

verified_by_reading.conclusion: A restart timeout is not accepted as shutdown success. Even when CLI returns UNCONFIRMED, current canonical inspection must show DRAINING_PENDING with the same owner PID/generation. The exact spawned child is alive, claim/slot/birth remain equal, stop proof remains absent, operation IDs remain unchanged and the physical work marker contains one record.
Explicit close is admitted while the native turn is active; close is held until the terminal result is observed, and the child remains alive with its slot retained before release.

After explicit release, child exit0 and observed physical stop are required, then slot release and SUCCEEDED close receipt. Server owner must exit0; status must be stopped and durable shutdown state DRAINED for the same generation. No replacement or repeated native effect is accepted.
The physical child exchanges one WORK/ACK and exits through STOP. Watchdog exit88 cannot satisfy the required exit0.

limits: Read-only review; no test was executed by this reviewer for this file.
This exercises the literal live-child branch. The child belongs to Core in the Connector process, which remains alive; it does not claim that the child survives death of its owning process.
Native/provider protocol behavior is synthetic. No real provider, personal credentials or operating-system service registration is qualified.
The review is bounded to the frozen test and its oracles; installed execution remains parent-owned.
